violation_type.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §747.2321(a))
violation_type.short_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional
violation_type.typical_finding: There were no written feeding instructions for the infant in care.

finding_variants.text: There were no written feeding instructions for the infant in care.
The operation has one infant enrolled and does not have an infant feeding plan.
Feeding instructions for two children not yet eating table food and under the age of 12mo are missing.
During the inspection the daycare did not have feeding instruction for an infant not yet on table food.
The operation did not have feeding instructions for one child in care.
Written feeding instructions is needed for one infant in care.
